page_title: GEN 1-1 PIS | Genoa v Pisa 03/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Daniele Chiffi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' Flag goes up against Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Samuele Angori (Pisa), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
86' Vitinha (Genoa) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
84' The referee signals a substitution. Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa) is brought on as a substitute for Sebastian Otoa.
83' Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) sees a yellow card from Daniele Chiffi after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
81' The corner is swung in but Pisa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' Genoa players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) will replace Lorenzo Colombo.
75' Here comes a substitution. Brooke Norton-Cuffy is given a rest as he is replaced by Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa).
74' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
72' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Stefano Moreo is replaced by M'Bala Nzola (Pisa).
72' A substitution has been made. Giovanni Bonfanti is replaced by Arturo Calabresi (Pisa).
71' Pisa quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
67' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
66' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 4:2.
64' Substitution. Morten Thorsby leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
62' Raul Albiol is substituted due to injury. Alberto Gilardino gives a chance to Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa).
61' Raul Albiol (Pisa) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Pisa take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
58' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marius Marin (Pisa) replacing Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris.
58' The manager makes a subsitution with Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) coming on for Malthe Hojholt.
57' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
54' Vitinha (Genoa) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
51' Daniele Chiffi shows a yellow card to Simone Canestrelli (Pisa) for a tough tackle.
49' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
47' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Pisa.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Daniele Chiffi shows the yellow card to Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) for a heavy challenge.
42' The resulting set piece from Pisa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
38' 1 - 1 Goal! Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) gets to the ball inside the box, sees the goalkeeper off his line and lifts the ball over him and into the back of the net. 1:1.
38' Pisa have a free kick.
37' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Daniele Chiffi ignores the protests.
36' Pisa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
34' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) takes it short.
33' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the roof of the net, but Nicola Leali is alert and denies him.
29' Malthe Hojholt (Pisa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.
25' A spell of possession for Genoa in an attempt to control the game.
21' Vitinha (Genoa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' The shots on goal statistics – 3:0.
15' 1 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom left corner.
12' Vitinha (Genoa) takes the corner which is cleared.
12' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Vitinha (Genoa) causes Adrian Semper little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
10' Genoa fail to score from a corner as Adrian Semper (Pisa) leaps to collect the ball.
8' Vitinha (Genoa) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.

4' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) jumps highest to head the ball from the resulting free kick on the edge of the box! A difficult position to score from and the keeper reacts coolly to make a comfortable save.
3' Genoa win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Genoa will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Daniele Chiffi will supervise the game today.
